paragraphs.text:
“P–Professor?” The voice is unmistakably Sylvia’s. You calm her 
with a whisper and she hugs you, overcome. She seems in good 
shape, considering. You explain that you must sneak away from 
camp at once.

Make a Stealth roll for Norman, Sylvia, and yourself: if all three 
succeed, go to 395; if any of you fail, go to 653.
